One-bowl cocoa cake

A moist everyday cocoa cake made in a single bowl.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups plain / all purpose flour
  • 1/2 cup cocoa powder , unsweetened (Note 2)
  • 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp baking soda (bi-carb soda)
  • 1 1/2 cups caster sugar (Note 1)
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 3 eggs (~55-65g / 2 oz each)
  • 1 cup buttermilk (low or full fat)
  • 1/2 cup vegetable oil (or canola)
  • 2 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup boiling water
  • 1 1/2 batches Cream Cheese Frosting (slide scaler on recipe)

Instructions

  • Preheat oven to 170C°/340°F (150°C fan). Read Note 3 about rack positions.
  • Grease 2 x 20cm/8" round pans with butter and line the bases. (Note 4 on other pan sizes).
  • Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, sugar and salt in a large bowl.
  • Add the eggs, buttermilk, oil and vanilla and beat on low until smooth.
  • Stir in the boiling water; the batter will be thin.
  • Divide between the pans and bake for 30 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
  • Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn out and cool completely.
  • Sandwich and cover with the frosting.
